name: Parameters.dvd_norm_c₀
summary: p divides N₀(P) ∣ 2(d(P) + 1) = 2³·((d(P) + 1)/4); if p ∣ 2³ then p = 2, which divides (d(P) + 1)/4 as 8 ∣ d(P) + 1.

steps.claim: As p is prime and divides 2³·((d(P) + 1)/4) (1.1), p divides 2³ or p divides (d(P) + 1)/4.
steps.lean:
lemma dvd_norm_c₀ {s} (hp : p.Prime) (h : p ∣ P.N₁ s) : p ∣ (P.d + 1) / 4 := (hp.dvd_or_dvd
  (m := 2 ^ 3) (.trans (by grind [hp.dvd_mul, hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow, dvd_trans, towerDeg]) (P.5.1.trans
  ⟨1, by grind [PrimeSevenModEight]⟩))).elim (by grind [hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow ·, dvd_trans,
  PrimeSevenModEight]) id

steps.claim: p ∣ 2³·((d(P) + 1)/4): p divides N₀(P) — p ∣ N₁(P, s) = N₀(P)·3^c·2^s, so p ∣ N₀(P), p ∣ 3 or p ∣ 2, and 2, 3 ∣ N₀(P) — and N₀(P) ∣ 2(d(P) + 1) = 2³·((d(P) + 1)/4)·1, because d(P) ≡ 7 mod 8 (instance PrimeSevenModEight).
steps.lean:
(.trans (by grind [hp.dvd_mul, hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow, dvd_trans, towerDeg]) (P.5.1.trans
  ⟨1, by grind [PrimeSevenModEight]⟩))

steps.claim: If p ∣ 2³ then p = 2, and 2 divides (d(P) + 1)/4 because 8 ∣ d(P) + 1.
If p ∣ (d(P) + 1)/4 there is nothing to show.
